descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S01 Existing specs: Hospital dashboard counts the whole roster and stays live; the list's Dashboard control reaches it

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 With the dashboard open, the counts update without a page reload when a note is generated or an encounter is completed (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3; TFA-92598 How it works 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T3 The app counts every patient in Total and in exactly one of Pending (not yet prepped), In Progress and Complete, and shows the counts prominently (TFA-92598 How it works 1; TFA-92598 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's resident test account. 50 filler patients sort ahead of the target (more than one 50-row page), plus one patient in Nursing Home. navigation.spec.ts uses its own fixture patient

When Open /rounding, tap Dashboard. A second client moves the target through pre-rounded, in-encounter, seen, note-ready, post-rounded and a day reset to pending, then removes it and adds another patient. …

Then Total covers all 51 rows. Total = Pending + In Progress + Complete. Each write moves exactly one count while the dashboard stays open (no reload). The Nursing Home patient is absent. The 'Rounding Dashboard' heading shows from the list's Dashboard control, and a row opens /rounding/<that id>

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in both specs. The statuses are written straight through rounding.update, not by Generate or Mark Encounter Complete in the UI, so this is evidence for liveness, totals and the page boundary, not for UAT step 3 as written (S09). …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S01

Existing specs: Hospital dashboard counts the whole roster and stays live; the list's Dashboard control reaches it

Tickets: TFA-92598 Rounding Dashboard (ready for qa)

Lane in the dev run folder newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Dev (, build 25acd727, live models), PW spec dsh-tc20-dev.spec.ts driving the app UI. Judged 7/7. 51 Hospital rows (past the 50-row page; the shared account had no other rows): Total 51 = the stored rows, all 51 listed, no Nursing Home row. A row added by another client appears and Total / Pending go +1 within 0.3 s with the dashboard open, removing it takes it out again, no reload. Status changes cannot be written from outside on dev (no rounding:update on the allow list); the live status moves are judged through the app's own Generate / Complete in S09.

Evidence: 2 attached; 1 not attached:

  • newspec-c/evidence/dsh-192030/evidence/d2-rounding-dashboard.png — a dev screenshot, not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright specs on the local stack: they sign in their own fixture accounts and write through e2e/support/backend.ts with the admin key; dev has neither (runner-contract §10), so this runs on the local stack only.. This dev newspec-c result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local matrix (lane A)] passed (matrix/TC-20.results.json)
  • [local newspec-c] passed (newspec-c/results.json) — newspec-c: passed → passed (passed) PW, local stack 25acd727, model mocked or blocked at the socket (tripwire clean). Judged 3/3. Two parts on 25acd727. (1) Tim's 'rounding: the complete roster stays live across pagination and status changes' (rounding-dashboard.spec.ts, chromium) run by title: passed (8.0 s): 50 fillers + the target, Total covers all 51, every status write moves exactly one tile…
  • [local datasets] passed (datasets/results.json) — datasets: passed → passed (passed) 14 judged cell(s) held
